prompt:
[INST] Which of the following countries is the least populated? A. France 
B. England 
C. Russia 
D. Japan [/INST]
response: Out of the options given, the least populated is England. According to the latest United Nations data, the current population of England in 2021 is approximately 56,286,961 while the other countries have larger populations: France has about 65,426,179, Japan has about 126,050,804 and Russia has about 145,912,025 people.
